notes.title: Update Notes for April 1 2021
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] All nations can now be selected with CTRL+A
[*] Cancelling a nation selection with Backspace got implemented
[*] An already occupied shortcut key can now easily be assigned to another action without having to            change the previous one
[*] Steam Cloud saves got implemented
[*] Fixed unresponsiveness after zooming in or out
[*] Moved the in-game announcements that were centered on the screen to be less obscuring
[*] Further bug fixes
[/list]

notes.title: First Strike: Classic Remaster Update
notes.notes:
Hello dear tactical annihilators from all around the world!

Today we have a special announcement to make. First Strike: Final Hour will get a massive update today, becoming First Strike: Classic.

Why is that? Well, you see, this Saturday, First Strike is turning 7 years old. And for this special celebration we did something special: We used the last months during the global lockdowns to remaster the whole game from the ground up.

First Strike: Classic is a new rebuild of the original First Strike, including:
[list]
[*] A new codebase completely rebuilt from the ground up to fight bugs 
[*] A massively smarter AI with brand new behaviors 
[*] Newly refreshed and redesigned interface 
[*] And it is free of charge as an update for all First Strike fans
[/list]

We’ve heard the feedback that First Strike was having some issues lately. Not only is this version more merciless and sleeker than ever before, we also hope this update will help to make First Strike ready for another nuclear decade.

If you are interested in celebrating the anniversary with us, join the festivities this Saturday when we're doing a special livestream with the community. All the links are on this hub page:
[url=https://firststrike.mobi/nuclear-war-celebration-day]Nuclear Celebration Day HUB[/url]

Thank you all for sticking with First Strike for so long and we hope you are having a ton of fun with this remaster and with figuring out the creative ways to blow up the world.

Remember: The only winning move is not to play.... or is it?

notes.title: Celebrating the AIRHEART physical release - First Strike: Final Hour gets a 60% discount!
notes.notes:
It's something we always dreamed of, and today it will happen: our first physical release! Airheart, our game where you hunt for fish above the clouds, will get a disc version for PlayStation 4, published by Limited Run Games. Make sure to check out the [url=https://www.limitedrungames.com/collections/neo-frontpage/products/limited-run-269-airheart-ps4]LRG store[/url] today to order your copy, it's limited to 1500 prints!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28290267/2c56046ffd51b55d52f5173720dad5c862854a56.jpg[/img]

We're extremely happy, and to celebrate the occasion we discounted the Steam versions of First Strike: Final Hour for 60% and Cloud Chasers for 40%.

As for the Airheart disc release: every copy comes with a poster and a reversible cover (as well as a special LRG skin for an airplane), and there's also a bundle where you get the original Airheart soundtrack. We love the music that Michel Barengo (also composer of the First Strike soundtrack) creates, so we'd go for that version ;). 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28290267/064257497201bd99da40ad342acbefe59d49d2b0.jpg[/img]

As for the future of First Strike --> subscribe to our [url=www.firststrikefinalhour.com]First Strike[/url] mailing list and you'll be among the first to know what's up. We'll have some news very soon! We know you can't wait - and it's the same for us! ːsteamhappyː

Your Blindflug Studios Team

notes.title: Celebrating "Cloud Chasers" release on Steam - First Strike Final Hour is 50% off!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28290267/8f7a62eaffb3c88e6cdb27165231021d2cc4bcca.png[/img]

Looking for an action-adventure with an epic story and unique gameplay? Search no more! We are proud to present to you our critically acclaimed game "Cloud Chasers" - now available for Windows and Mac.

Meet Francisco and his daughter Amelia, who need to leave their farm.  Since all the water from the clouds is collected by harvesters from the world above, the fertile land turned into a desert.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/751670/Cloud_Chasers__Journey_of_Hope/]>>> Get "Cloud Chasers - Journey of Hope" on Steam <<<[/url]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28290267/a4dac0b76d7a05854fecdff6f330445eecbed239.png[/img]

Begin the dangerous journey through five deserts and experience multiple narrative encounters. Make the right decisions, trade items and try to make it to the Spire - a city above the clouds.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28290267/5bfedf55f27c99f929bea50fd03d9e9b98b26ba2.png[/img]

On the desert, water is your most valuable resource - collect it flying through the clouds with your glider. Be careful though - harvesters from the world above don't like competition and they will try to stop you.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28290267/a09d481cc8eea3776ba0c111314d8c63860de0a0.png[/img]

We hope you will find the story of Amelia and Francisco interesting. Thanks for playing our games!

Blindflug Team
